title: Why refs and set functions can be left out

slides.text: Where is ref in the deps? 🤔
slides.say: This Effect uses both ref and is playing, but only lists is playing. Is that a bug?
No. React guarantees the same ref object from the same use ref call on every render. It never changes, so it can never re-run the Effect.

slides.text: set functions from useState are stable too. Listing them is allowed, it just changes nothing.
slides.say: Set functions from use state are stable too. You can include them or leave them out. If the linter is happy, it is safe.

slides.text: But a ref passed in as a prop must be listed: the parent could pass a different one.
slides.say: One catch: if the ref comes from a parent as a prop, list it. The parent might pass a different ref.
